slides.title: Ethiopia's PM makes two demands of Eritrea

slides.text: On **Nov 26**, PM Abiy asked Eritrea to **stop arming groups** he calls hostile to Ethiopia, state media **ENA** reports.
He also sought **joint development**, saying Eritrea **rejected offers** on electricity, roads and ports, **ENA** reports.
**No direct Eritrean reply** yet, **bne IntelliNews** reported; an Eritrean ministry commentary that day alleged Ethiopian **territorial ambitions**.
**Choose dialogue, protect civilians.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: ENA (state media); bne IntelliNews via Yahoo, Nov 26, 2026
